items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I worked with Henry Hardin with Alvin's brother, George McCullough.

ctx.x: I worked with Henry Hardin. I worked with Henry Hardin with Alvin's brother, George McCullough. Uh huh. With the first trumpet player. Gilbert Young was the second trumpet player. Russell's third trumpet player.
